recognize_zh: 低倍骨髓切片可見骨小梁間仍有不少脂肪空泡，標註為相對兒童年齡偏低的細胞量；造血區呈單調、密集的小圓細胞分布，缺乏正常三系混雜的樣貌，需高倍與免疫染色確認是芽細胞浸潤。
features: Low power core biopsy with bony trabeculae and intertrabecular marrow containing abundant fat spaces
Cellularity reduced relative to expected pediatric cellularity (per label)
Hematopoietic areas appear monotonous with densely packed small round cells
Megakaryocytes not readily identified at this magnification
No fibrosis or granulomas evident at low power
describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy at low power shows trabecular bone with intertrabecular marrow containing numerous fat spaces, hypocellular for the patient's age. The hematopoietic areas appear monotonous and composed of densely packed small round cells, with megakaryocytes not readily identified. Cytologic detail is limited at this magnification, and high-power examination and immunostains are needed to characterize the infiltrate. In conjunction with the aspirate and immunophenotype, findings are consistent with involvement by T-lymphoblastic leukemia in a hypocellular marrow.

ddx.vs: Aplastic marrow is markedly fatty with residual cells being lymphocytes, plasma cells and stroma rather than monotonous immature cells; CD34/TdT and aspirate blast counts separate them.
Hypocellular MDS shows dysplastic megakaryocytes and myeloid/erythroid lineages with possible CD34+ blasts, not a CD3+ lymphoblast infiltrate.
Blasts in hypocellular AML are myeloid (MPO, CD117, CD33) rather than T-lineage.
